articles.summary: NEW YORK, September 1, 2026 – Immunic, Inc. (Nasdaq: IMUX), today announced the appointment of Chitrang Davé as Chief Data and Digital Officer (CDDO), effective today. Mr. Davé will report directly to Chief Executive Officer Erik Lundgren and will serve as a member of the executive leadership team.
articles.title: Immunic Appoints Chitrang Davé as Chief Data and Digital Officer
